                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • How it fooled us on 4 Nov: the company renamed its X from @cubecomputer_ to @collabs_inc, someone took the free name (new account, made 3 Nov) and put this token's address in its bio.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     • cube.computer now links only x.com/collabs_inc (on 4 Nov it still linked x.com/cubecomputer_). FAQ and billing): it never mentions a token, $CUBE, crypto, a wallet or Robinhood Chain
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Real paid product: cloud computers for coding agents, $6 per vCPU a month, $25 free credit; paid by card through Stripe, not with the token

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 5 Nov: the launch wallet 0xbe3c1c76... burned its whole first buy (7.2M CUBE) at 11:46 UTC on 4 Nov, 6 minutes after launch, and sold nothing. The selling came from other wallets
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Wrong on 4 Nov: we called it 'team launched it' from the @cubecomputer_ bio.
